reviews.machine: Intel Core i9-14900K, x86_64 little endian

method.main_io: baseline and candidate use identical frozen common fast I/O; core alternatives and driver alternatives are identified separately
method.timing: subprocess end-to-end perf_counter_ns, stdout=/dev/null, no timeout polling in timed runs; interleaved forward/reverse candidate order
method.candidate_repetitions: 2 warmup and 7 measured runs per case/compiler
method.unchanged_repetitions: 1 warmup and 3 measured runs per case/compiler
method.small_reference: independent Python naive arrays, sets, dictionaries, per-version copied DSU, fixed-potential DSU, point/line scans and node visit sets
method.cases: small, large random, degenerate; Wavelet also construction-heavy q=1; Fenwick additionally 2,000,000 add + 2,000,000 sum core-only cases
method.excluded_artifacts: *.invalid_polling.json used subprocess timeout polling and are invalid for timing; *_initial.json are superseded when the generator or candidate set was improved
method.scope_limit: local measurements are synthetic and do not establish online AC or online timing; parent must synchronize generated submissions and resubmit changed source
